'''''Festuca valesiaca''''', the '''Volga fescue''', is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Poaceae]]. It is native to Europe and Asia. It was [[introduced species|introduced]] to North America when it was deliberately planted.<ref name=gm>Darbyshire, S. J. and L. E. Pavlick. (2007). [http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Festuca_valesiaca&type=treatment ''Festuca valesiaca''.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304052432/http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Festuca_valesiaca&type=treatment |date=2016-03-04 }} In Barkworth, et al. (Eds.), ''Flora of North America'' vol. 25.</ref> There it can be found in such [[United States|US]] states as [[Arizona]], [[Kansas]], [[Montana]], [[Vermont]] and [[Wyoming]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://plants.usda.gov/java/profile?symbol=FEVA2|title=''Festuca valesiaca'' Schleich. ex Gaudin|publisher=PLANTS Profile|work=[[United States Department of Agriculture|USDA]]|access-date=May 24, 2013}}</ref>
